objective: Compose infrastructure, snapshot and prediction readiness without circular prerequisites.
deliverable_refs: Version/freshness/deadline assessments and reason-coded mobile/API projections.
required_test_refs: Broker outage leaves scientific readiness unaffected.
Unknown clock, illegal dependency, missing artifact or model load mismatch blocks prediction.
Run readiness cannot require that the same run already has a completed prediction.
acceptance_gate: Each scientific stage exposes exact prerequisites and fails only for relevant unavailable evidence.
